description: Upstream clone is pinned and reproducible: a fresh machine can produce a byte-identical shotcraft.db from upstream/video-shotcraft.
steps: Delete platform/db/shotcraft.db
Run: python platform/ingest/run.py
Verify platform/db/shotcraft.db now exists
Run: python platform/query.py stats
Verify cards=157, styles=218, card_params=1057, pitfalls=792, motion_params=1607, rules=27
Verify the printed upstream SHA matches the SHA in upstream/video-shotcraft/.git

description: Card, style, media, parameter and pitfall tables match the upstream tree, with every divergence surfaced rather than dropped.
steps: Run: python platform/query.py cards --category camera
Verify the list matches references/shots/camera/*.md one-for-one
Run: python platform/query.py card crash-zoom-punch
Verify two styles are listed (crash-impact-real, crash-zoom-real) because demos/camera/crash-zoom-punch/ holds two components
Run: python platform/query.py params blur-slide
Verify motion parameters are returned with line numbers
Verify any library.json style key without a matching demo appears in the ingest warnings rather than being silently dropped

description: Search works in Chinese, English and slugs. unicode61 cannot match inside a Chinese phrase and trigram cannot do 1-2 character queries, so the search must cascade.
steps: Run: python platform/query.py search 转场
Verify at least one transition card is returned
Run: python platform/query.py search 弹簧
Verify at least one card is returned
Run: python platform/query.py search overshoot
Verify at least one card is returned
Run: python platform/query.py search spring
Verify at least one card is returned
Run: python platform/query.py search crash-zoom
Verify crash-zoom-punch is returned
Run: python platform/query.py search cut
Verify at least one card is returned

description: The LLM wiki is generated from the DB and is complete: llms.txt, llms-full.txt, 9 domain documents, 157 card pages, index.json, openapi.json.
steps: Run: python platform/wiki/build_wiki.py
Verify it reports cards=157, domains=9
Verify wiki/llms.txt, wiki/llms-full.txt, wiki/index.json and wiki/api/openapi.json exist
Count files in wiki/cards/*.md and verify it is 157
Open wiki/cards/crash-zoom-punch.md and verify Identity, Variants, Parameters and Known pitfalls sections are all present
Open wiki/domains/motion-grammar.md and verify it lists the house easing curve and the observed spring configs
Re-run build_wiki.py and verify no file changes (deterministic)

description: The wiki answers real craft questions without upstream file access, and it never claims the free core is sellable.
steps: Ask 20 craft questions using only files under wiki/
Verify at least 18 are answered correctly
Open wiki/domains/licensing.md and verify Remotion and PolyForm Noncommercial are marked as blocking
Open wiki/domains/monetization.md and verify it contains an explicit 'what we are not doing' section
Verify no generated page claims the Apache-2.0 core is exclusive to us

description: The live site mirrors completely, including the mp4 previews that are not in git.
steps: Run: python platform/mirror_site.py --out upstream/site-mirror
Verify index.html, library.html, showcase.html, app.js, showcase.js, translations.js, styles.css and api/library.json are present
Run: python platform/mirror_site.py --out upstream/site-mirror --media
Verify the command reports missing_previews=0
Verify the exit code is 0
Compare the mirrored api/library.json with upstream/video-shotcraft/gallery/api/library.json and verify cardCount=157 and styleCount=214

description: Upstream translations.js is extracted to per-locale JSON with byte-identical strings, and the site still renders identically in en and zh.
steps: Run the extraction script and verify locales/en/*.json and locales/zh/*.json are produced
Verify locales/en/cards.json has 157 entries and locales/en/styles.json has 214
Run: python platform/query.py stats and verify translations equals the sum of extracted strings
Open dist/en/library.html and dist/zh/library.html and verify both render 157 cards
Compare a screenshot of the pre-change library.html with dist/en/library.html at the same viewport and verify they are pixel-identical
Verify build-seo.py's string-slice parser is no longer used for the English card map

description: One i18n runtime replaces the three upstream inline mechanisms, and the language switcher works from every page.
steps: Open dist/<locale>/index.html, library.html and showcase.html
Verify none of them contain an inline L10N or SHOWCASE_L10N object
Verify each loads one shared i18n module and one locale JSON bundle
Switch language from the library page and verify the hero, the filters and the card names all change
Switch language from the showcase page and verify its strings change
Verify the three mechanisms collapsed into one: no duplicate dictionary for the same key exists across pages

description: Locales are addressable in the URL with correct hreflang, canonical and locale-qualified sitemap entries.
steps: Request /ru/library.html and verify HTTP 200
Verify every page in every locale emits link rel=alternate hreflang for all 9 locales plus x-default
Verify each page has a self-referencing canonical matching its own URL
Verify / redirects to the best-guess locale from Accept-Language
Verify the root HTML contains a visible language switcher without JavaScript
Verify sitemap.xml contains a locale-qualified entry for every locale x page combination
Verify a deep link such as /ru/library.html#crash-zoom-punch still resolves to the card

description: Per-locale card and style dictionaries are generated from the DB, so no locale requires hand-editing translations.js.
steps: Run the site build for locale ru
Verify site/dist/ru/library.html shows all 157 cards
Verify ru card text came from the translation table and not from a hand-edited file
Verify no card name is left as its English slug unless it is a proper noun such as Ink Press
Run the site build for a locale with no translations yet and verify it falls back to en instead of rendering empty strings

description: Locale coverage is measurable and gated, not a matter of opinion.
steps: Run: python platform/query.py stats and read the translations count
For each locale compute translated/source ratio
Verify a CI check fails the build when a locale falls below the agreed coverage threshold
Verify the same check flags any string identical to its English value
Verify per-locale font stack is applied, including CJK for zh, ja and ko

description: A read-only HTTP API serves the index described by wiki/api/openapi.json.
steps: Start the API server and request /stats
Verify the response matches platform/query.py stats
Request /cards?category=camera and verify only camera cards are returned
Request /cards?energy=high and verify the energy rank filter is applied
Request /cards/crash-zoom-punch and verify parameters, pitfalls and styles are included
Request /cards?q=<a Chinese phrase> and verify results are returned
Verify no endpoint accepts a write verb

description: A brand kit can be layered over the upstream template without editing the upstream template.
steps: Install one brand kit over upstream/video-shotcraft/template
Verify the film renders and the palette, fonts and textures come from the kit
Verify no file under the kit's own directory is modified by the install
Verify the kit can be removed cleanly
Verify the same procedure works on a fresh clone of the template

description: An upstream release bump is a scripted, reviewable operation.
steps: Pull the new upstream SHA into upstream/video-shotcraft
Run: python platform/ingest/run.py
Run: python platform/wiki/build_wiki.py
Review git diff of wiki/index.json and confirm only the expected counts and new cards changed
Verify the new SHA is recorded in source_repo.head_sha
Verify no row lost its source_file_id, so the change is traceable

description: The whole pipeline is reproducible from a clean checkout with one command.
steps: Clone the workspace into a fresh directory
Run the init script
Verify it clones upstream if absent, then ingests, then builds the wiki
Verify it exits 0 and prints the resulting counts
Verify it is silent and fast when everything is already up to date
